ABOUT THIS EXPERIENCE

About the experience

Explore the proposed development in Kokapet, then enter a furnished interpretation of a brochure layout.

Architecture and plans

The masterplan, two wings, amenities and thirteen residence designs come from the developer brochure. The exterior dimensions, floor elevations and furnished interiors are illustrative. The apartment plan shows the brochure’s room dimensions.

Surroundings and views

Mapped roads, building footprints, elevation samples and satellite imagery form the geographic setting. The balcony outlook is a simulation. Confirm architectural specifications, orientation and views with the developer.

Saved homes and comparisons stay in this browser. You can download an enquiry note to share yourself.

Architectural sources · Map and imagery credits

Space for a fuller life.

Amenities and images from the supplied brochure. Illustrations are artist’s impressions; confirm current specifications and inclusions with the developer.
